title: How Do You Know?
synopsis:
Gao Tian is having breakfast in the school cafeteria, where he runs into Anne, who is also there for breakfast. They discuss their breakfast and Teacher Li’s condition.
In this lesson, you will learn how to ask about other people’s preferences as well as express your own personal preferences.

fullText.simplified:
你是怎么知道的？

高天：Anne！你怎么来学校了？你的病好了吗？
Anne：高天，早上好！我的病已经好了。
高天：太好了！这两天你没来学校，我的学习都不好了。你现在觉得怎么样？
Anne：现在觉得不错，很想吃东西。
高天：你想吃什么？今天的面条不错，你吃不吃？
Anne：我不喜欢早上吃面条，我想吃鸡蛋，再喝点儿牛奶。
高天：鸡蛋好吃吗？
Anne：我觉得好吃，你要不要试一试？还有牛奶也不错，你也喝喝。
高天：好，我都试试。
Anne：今天下午没有课，我们去医院看李老师吧！
高天：李老师昨天已经出院了，明天会来学校。
Anne：啊！她怎么就出院了？她的病好了吗？
高天：已经好了，医生说她在家休息两天，就可以回学校上班了。
Anne：太好了！你是怎么知道的？
高天：我昨天在商店看到李老师的女儿了，她在买牛奶，是她告诉我的。
fullText.traditional:
你是怎麼知道的？

高天：Anne！你怎麼來學校了？你的病好了嗎？
Anne：高天，早上好！我的病已經好了。
高天：太好了！這兩天你沒來學校，我的學習都不好了。你現在覺得怎麼樣？
Anne：現在覺得不錯，很想吃東西。
高天：你想吃什麼？今天的麵條不錯，你吃不吃？
Anne：我不喜歡早上吃麵條，我想吃雞蛋，再喝點兒牛奶。
高天：雞蛋好吃嗎？
Anne：我覺得好吃，你要不要試一試？還有牛奶也不錯，你也喝喝。
高天：好，我都試試。
Anne：今天下午沒有課，我們去醫院看李老師吧！
高天：李老師昨天已經出院了，明天會來學校。
Anne：啊！她怎麼就出院了？她的病好了嗎？
高天：已經好了，醫生說她在家休息兩天，就可以回學校上班了。
Anne：太好了！你是怎麼知道的？
高天：我昨天在商店看到李老師的女兒了，她在買牛奶，是她告訴我的。

sentence_translations: Gao Tian: Anne! Why did you come to school? Have you recovered from your illness?
Anne: Good morning, Gao Tian! I have already recovered.
Gao Tian: That’s great! The past two days that you haven’t been at school, I haven’t been doing well in my studies.
Anne: I’m feeling good right now. I really want to eat something.
Gao Tian: What do you want to eat? The noodles are good today. Do you want to eat some?
Anne: I don’t like eating noodles in the morning. I want to eat eggs and also drink some milk.
Gao Tian: Are the eggs tasty?
Anne: I think they’re tasty. Do you want to try some? The milk is good as well. You should try it.
Gao Tian: Okay, I’ll give them a try.
Anne: We don’t have class this afternoon. Let’s go to the hospital to visit Teacher Li!
Gao Tian: Teacher Li was discharged from the hospital yesterday. She will come to school tomorrow.
Anne: Ah! How come she’s been discharged from the hospital? Has she recovered?
Gao Tian: She has already recovered. The doctor told her to stay home to rest for two days, then she can go back to work at the school.
Anne: Great! How do you know?
Gao Tian: I saw Teacher Li’s daughter at the store yesterday. She was buying milk, and she told me.
